Privacy Policy ← Back to Earthworm Virtual Laboratory Back Effective date: 28 September 2026 Overview Earthworm Virtual Laboratory is an offline educational application for undergraduate Zoology teaching. It is designed to work without a user account, advertising, analytics, or remote data collection. Information collected The app does not ask for or collect a student’s name, email address, phone number, location, contacts, camera data, microphone recordings, photos, files, or advertising identifier. The Android application requests no INTERNET permission and includes no advertising or analytics SDK. Information stored on the device The app may keep limited learning-state and preference information locally on the device so the learning experience can continue between sessions. Depending on the features used, this may include: language preference the last selected anatomical system or structure locally stored assessment score/state fields, where used a local privacy-policy acknowledgement state This information is not transmitted by the app to the developer, college, advertisers, or analytics services. Android cloud backup is disabled. Local app data normally remains until the user clears app data or uninstalls the app. Speech Narration uses Android text-to-speech voices installed on the device. The app selects voices reported by Android as not requiring a network connection. The application does not send narration text to an online speech service. External links The app itself does not load remote web content because it has no INTERNET permission. Public store-policy and scientific reference addresses may be opened separately in a web browser by the user. The browser and visited websites have their own privacy practices. Advertising and analytics The app contains no advertising SDK and no analytics SDK. The developer does not sell or share student information with advertisers. Children and students The app does not create user accounts and does not knowingly collect personal information from children or students. Learning-state information remains on the device. Security and retention The app is designed as an offline teaching resource with local-only storage. Local app data remains on the device until the user clears the app’s data or uninstalls the application. Changes to this policy If a future release changes permissions, network behaviour, analytics, account systems, or data handling, this policy will be updated before that release is distributed.
